theory-uncertainty.summary: Assemble supplied prediction members, explicit uncertainty prescriptions and declared class covariance.
requires: supplied prediction metadata and all members
source-bound isolated PDF worker result when PDF members are present

operations.summary: Prediction bands and declared theory covariance from supplied member tables or multiweight YODA text.
operations.applicability_predicate: Explicit binning, program and order, PDF metadata, normalization, supplied members, prescriptions and correlation models
operations.schema_notes: prediction_bundle.v1; no physics validation is inferred; unknown streams are retained and completeness is computed

interfaces.band: band(bundle, *, pdf_result=None) -> {minus, plus, by_class, combination, unclassified}
interfaces.theory_covariance: theory_covariance(bundle, model, *, pdf_result=None) -> {by_class, total, correlation_model, symmetrization, class_correlation, law}
interfaces.isolated_worker: rivet environment Python executes lhapdf_worker.py --request PATH --output PATH through existing method admission and supervised execution

handoff: Registration lane applies this fragment to shared registries and science-worker dispatch, declares the workflow resource, then regenerates the instruction bundle and knowledge atlas. Downstream consumers pass supplied bundles and explicit correlation models. PDF set identity and member population are supplied through the PDF catalogue interface. No shared registry or orchestration file was rewritten.
